parsed.explanation: The dossier documents state-tolerated organised targeting rather than mere disapproval: a police register of LGBTIQ people (2016), a government registry of 'proven' LGBT persons, 2024 police entrapment luring people into fake meetings to register and extort them (10+ cases in one province), 2022–23 raids with forced HIV testing, arbitrary charges, ill-treatment, sexual abuse and extortion, and 27 recorded violation cases in 2024 including police arrest and blackmail. Police are the threat, not a protector; complaints go nowhere (sham marriages ignored, no SOGI discrimination protection, activists barred from state access). This is tier-2 state-involved targeting with high outing probability engineered by the state itself — surveillance and registration raise discovery risk. Severity: extortion, abuse, arbitrary detention; no documented imprisonment-for-presentation or execution campaign, so not 0.15, but the ongoing documented police predation and zero recourse place it at the top of the high-risk band. Border/custody questions are unresolved, but thin-data extrapolation follows the structural facts: repressive state, no protection, active targeting.
